Definition: from G3324; to replenish, i.e. (by implication) to intoxicate:--fill.
BiblicalUsage: Mestoo means to fill, to replenish, and in its one use it is mockery. Acts 2:13 says, Others mocking said, These men are full of new wine.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the mockers got it backwards: the men were full, but not of wine, and the filling they mocked was the Spirit.
